subject.title: feat(config): use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may the new cleanup policy prune them on first write?
rationale: Config backups may be a user's only recovery copy, and repository policy treats config recovery and migration behavior as compatibility-sensitive rather than an automation-only choice.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamped retention set.

options.title: Prune Legacy Numbered Backups
options.body: Accept a clean timestamp-only scheme even if first-run cleanup removes existing numbered backups.

options.title: Keep The Numeric Ring
options.body: Reject the timestamped naming change for now and document the numbered ring as the intended stable behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamped retention set.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history and review context on config backup and recovery semantics.
